﻿SEGA - Football Manager 27 Trailer Clipping
✓  You do not need a dedicated page for this campaign. You can post on any page.
⚠️ Audience Requirement: Minimum 50% USA and Canada audience. Either your page or the post itself can meet this. We will verify this with OAuth. 
 WHAT TO DO
* Post clips of moments from the official Football Manager 27 trailers.
* Use the FM27 Gameplay Rollout trailers and the FM27 Launch Trailer.
* Post on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
⚠️ Only use official FM27 trailer footage. Other footage is rejected.
	

Trailer links: [https://f.io/lfPRqwM7]
	 CAPTION GUIDELINES (REQUIRED)
MUST INCLUDE
✓  Tag @footballmanager (same handle on every platform)
✓  Disclosure hashtag (see FTC DISCLOSURE below)
YOUR CHOICE
* Everything else is up to you. Write your own caption around the required parts.
* Make the caption match the clip.
EXAMPLES
* A closer look at Football Manager 27. @footballmanager
#Ad
* FM27 match day. Which club are you managing first? @footballmanager
#Ad
* Watching the Football Manager 27 launch trailer again. @footballmanager
#Ad
NOTE
   * Keep it genuine. Write what a real fan would say.
   * Keep it true. No made-up facts, stats, or dates.
   * Write your own. Do not copy other clippers' captions.
 FTC DISCLOSURE (REQUIRED)
Every post MUST include one of these in the caption:
#Ad          #Advertisement          #Sponsored
	

   * Put it on its own separate line.
   * Make it the first hashtag after the post text.
   * You can add up to 3 more hashtags. They must relate to the content.
   * Keep it clear and easy to see. Do not bury it in a paragraph.
   * Use the same font, size, and color as the rest of the caption.
 LOGO REQUIREMENT (REQUIRED)
   * Add the official Football Manager logo to every clip as a watermark.
Logo download: https://brand.footballmanager.com/core-logos
	 ON-SCREEN TEXT (OPTIONAL)
   * If you add text, make it match the clip.
   * Same rule as captions. Keep it genuine and true.
 EDITING GUIDELINES
   * Background music: NOT ALLOWED. Use the original trailer audio only.
   * No AI voices. No AI voiceovers, AI narration, or AI-cloned voices.
 REQUIREMENTS
POST SPECS
✓  High-quality posts only. No blurry or low-effort content.
✓  Video must be at least 10 seconds long
✓  English content only
✓  Post must stay live for 30 days minimum
PERFORMANCE
✓  Minimum 0.20% engagement rate (1,000 views = at least 2 likes)
✓  Likes must be visible. Hidden likes = automatic rejection.
✓  Minimum 50% USA and Canada audience (your page or the post)
✓  By participating you agree to make your post FTC compliant
 NOT ALLOWED
CONTENT
❌  Political statements
❌  Comparisons with previous Football Manager games
❌  References to rival or competitor titles
❌  Footage that is not from the official FM27 trailers
❌  Low-quality or lazy uploads
❌  NSFW, violent, or controversial content
❌  Racist, homophobic, or sexual content = instant ban
❌  Reposting another creator's video as your own
❌  Exaggerated hooks, rage bait, or hate bait
❌  False or made-up claims, stats, or dates
❌  Mislabeling the content
❌  Any added music
❌  AI voiceovers or AI-generated voices
ENGAGEMENT FRAUD
❌  Bait posting: unrelated viral content to farm views
❌  Spam posting: the same video on multiple accounts
❌  Story boosting: story views do not count
❌  Paid promotion or ads of any kind = permanent ban
❌  Posting the same video more than 5 times
POST VIOLATIONS
❌  Removing the post before 30 days
❌  Hidden likes
Questions? Contact the Clipping Culture team, not the client. We manage this campaign and will help.
